law.catch_line: Guidelines and policies on student-athlete extreme heat safety and protection

text.section: The Board shall develop, biennially review and update as necessary, and distribute to each local school division guidelines on policies relating to extreme heat safety and protection for student-athletes that inform coaches, student-athletes, and student-athletes' parents of risks associated with and best-practices and strategies for ensuring the safety and protection of student-athletes when engaging in outdoor physical activity in times of extreme heat.
